subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on Jaguar engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the AJ200 across its E-Pace X540, F-Type X152 applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The AJ200 appears across two model lines — the E-Pace SUV and the F-Type sports car — offering a range of power outputs from 200 to 300 hp.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Timing chain, bearings, and gaskets as standard on every rebuild, with application-specific ancillaries accounted for once your exact model is confirmed.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: No widely-reported pattern is confirmed for the AJ200 petrol across any of its applications. That's a genuinely different situation from several other engines in our network where a specific wear pattern is well-documented — for the AJ200, we don't have one to report, and we won't invent one to sound more thorough.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page — they'll be added once a documented set of completed AJ200 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.

typical.title: JAGUAR AJ200 REBUILD
typical.intro: The following describes a typical rebuild scope for this engine — illustrative of the work involved, not a specific customer job. Real case studies from our own completed work will replace this section once available.
typical.body: The AJ200 is the petrol version of the 2.0-litre Ingenium engine, introduced a year after the diesel AJ200D. Like other Ingenium engines, the timing chain components are inspected thoroughly during a full rebuild, and the turbocharger is checked as part of the standard strip-down process. Full engine replacements require DME software matching, which we handle as part of the refit process.

scope.label: Typical Scope:
scope.text: Timing chain, bearings, gaskets, turbocharger inspection

cards.title: INSPECTION & STRIP-DOWN
cards.body: Careful inspection of the crankshaft, cylinder head, and timing chain components during strip-down.

cards.title: COMPONENT REPLACEMENT
cards.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, gaskets, seals, and timing chain components replaced as required.

cards.title: QUALITY CHECKS
cards.body: All major rotating assemblies, oil pump, and cooling system components inspected for long-term reliability.
